description:
This is a Special notice in conjuction with the current sources sought titled Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) for F.E. Warren AFB. 

Related notice on SAM is FA461326XXXX - Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) for F.E. Warren AFB - Sources Sought

FE Warren Air Force Base invites all interested contractors to two virtual sessions regarding an upcoming requirement. This is an opportunity to engage directly with government personnel and ask questions.

Session Schedule:

  • Tuesday, April 7, 2026, at 1:00 PM MT
  • Thursday, April 9, 2026, at 1:00 PM MT

Please see the Sources Sought posted on SAM titled Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) for F.E. Warren AFB for the Meeting ID/Passcode for the sessions. To have the links sent to you directly, please email Natalie Martinez at natalie.martinez.6@us.af.mil.
